paragraphs: Quest sells an online bidding platform that connects project solicitors with the bidding community. The company describes it as a bid management SaaS tool built to maximize efficiency and communication. Project solicitors like municipalities, engineers, and architects post bid advertisements on it.

Solicitors post all bidding documents on the platform and set the download price, and bidders then download the documents. Bidders download complete project bidding documentation through the eBidDoc system for previewing, printing, bidding, or quoting. Bidders who have downloaded an eBidDoc are automatically alerted of addenda and bid results.

Since its launch in 1999, Quest has grown into a construction project bidding data network in the United States. Bid opportunities can be searched across all 50 US states. A Plan Holder list updates when a prospective bidder downloads documents.

quote.text: Quest was designed to digitize, automate, perfect communication and effectively serve as the information channel for project solicitors and the entire bidding community.
